episodes.title: Buffalo '07
episodes.summary: The crime drama opens with teenagers Philip and Lukas meeting to share a kiss—and witnessing a murder, which they don't report out of fear of being outed. Complicating matters: Philip's foster mom is the sheriff, who's soon investigating the case.

episodes.title: Bless the Beast and the Children
episodes.summary: Philip and Lukas find proof that the killer lives; Helen tries to avoid allowing the case to impact her marriage; a new head of the task force is revealed.

episodes.title: Bella, Bella, Bella
episodes.summary: Helen seeks help from Agent Kamilah Davis in tracking a potential witness; and the boys skip school and head to a club in New York City that's not what Lukas expected.

episodes.title: Crème Brulée
episodes.summary: As Ryan attempts to shut down her case, Helen and Gabe's marriage is tested when her suspicions lead Philip to reveal a deep secret. Lukas creates a scandal to bury gay rumors at school.

episodes.title: The Lilies
episodes.summary: Ryan is forced to interfere with an autopsy as Helen gets closer to the truth. Philip deals with a surprise visit from his mom, and Lukas struggles with anxiety about the cabin murders.

episodes.title: The Yellow Couch
episodes.summary: Helen searches for the murder weapon; Kamila pulls Helen into a desperate search; Lukas is on the verge of his dream sponsorship.

episodes.title: They Lied
episodes.summary: Lukas and Philip embrace their romance; Helen uncovers new evidence on the shooter, and seeks Kamilah's help to protect Lukas.

episodes.title: The Larsons' Dog
episodes.summary: Ryan woos Kamilah in order to get close to Lukas; Helen develops a connection to Ryan; Gabe uncovers a clue to Helen's past.

episodes.title: Savior Unknown
episodes.summary: Ryan tries to cover his tracks; Helen's dark past threatens her marriage and her ability to protect her family.

episodes.title: Mother's Day
episodes.summary: Helen reels after learning the identity of the killer; when Lukas and Philip go missing, Helen races to find them.
